<div class="card-body">
'''Talz''' is a [[Light]] [[Character]] ([[Alien]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">タルズ</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">武器が命中した他のキャラクターと同じ位置カードにいれば、その代わりに没収してよい。命中を受けたキャラクターは元にもどされる。「夜間状態」にあるタルズは、戦闘力に＋２。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-31o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">マフタックは、帝国が隷属化した星系の内、アルゾックＩＩＩ出身のタルズ人男性である。二対の目の内小さな方は優れた暗視能力を持つ。マフタックはカーベの友人で保護者。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Talz.

'''Card text:''' If at the same site as another character just hit by a weapon, may forfeit in that character's place. The hit character is restored. A Talz under nighttime conditions is power +2.

'''Lore:''' Muftak is a male Talz from Alzoc III, a system enslaved by the Empire. The smaller pair of eyes gives excellent night vision. Muftak is a friend and protector of Kabe.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Talz]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 100. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
